title: The Soldiers' Mocking of Jesus
description: The governor's soldiers took Jesus into the praetorium, clothed him in a scarlet robe, put a crown of thorns on his head, and placed a reed in his right hand. They knelt before him, mocked him as King of the Jews, spat on him, and struck him with the reed. Then they took off the robe, dressed him in his own clothes, and led him away to be crucified. [ref:Matt 27:27-31|Matthew 27:27-31]
